title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode5 Members Needed!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He's awake! Tsukasa, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I passed out? That's right, it was all but a dream. There's no way that weird world, with the weird Miku, and a weird talking stuffed animal would be rea—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Does your head hurt?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It wasn't a dream?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is crazy... Why is this happening to me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well, this is a problem...
He's not in a state where we can try to uncover his true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I've had enough, I'm leaving!
If that “Untitled” song got me here, stopping it should take me back, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait a second, where's my phone...
It's gone! As if things weren't bad enough...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaargh! I'll do anything you want, but please release me! I'm losing my mind here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aaanything?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then will you perform with me as a cast member at the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If that's what I must do to get out of here, yes!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! It's a promise, right?
Okay, I'll help you find your phone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Where could it be...
I see it! It's hanging from a branch over there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What, really? That was quick!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I have the eyes of a hawk!
I'll go and get it for you. Whew! Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good job, Emu!
Now I just have to stop “Untitled” and I'll be out of here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, don't go yet!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ngh... Where am I?
Yes! It's the run-down stage from earlier!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I did it! I escaped from that nightmare!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I had a great time in that world!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's make shows that are as fun as that place!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Leave it to me!
No, wait.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are you roping me into your shows?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do you mean? You said you'd do anything to get back and I helped you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Um... Did I say that? I-I don't seem to recall...
Wasn't it all a dream anyway?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you promised...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Gotcha! How dare you kidnap Miss Emu!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: K-Kidnap?!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Don't try to deny it! I have video evidence on my hidden camera! You blinded me and young miss with your phone and abducted her!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's preposterous, I didn't do that! And why would a park mascot have a hidden camera?!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: That's irrelevant! You realized your mistake and brought young miss back, but what you did is still a crime!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh! It hurts! Stop!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What did I get myself into this time? Kidnapping? Miss? Why's this guy so deferential towards her anyway?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No fighting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa is my very special friend, who's going to do shows with me! Shows that everyone will love!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So be nice to each other!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: *freeze*

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Is that true? You'll be working on this stage with young miss Emu?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's um, complicated...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: *grips harder*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Urgh... How come this mascot's so strong?!
Is he going to crush the life out of me if I give the wrong answer?)

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I asked you if you're going to do shows with young miss Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes! That's right! Emu and I will perform here together!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Are you telling the truth?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Eek! Y-Yes, absolutely, pinky swear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Cough*... *Cough*... This is coercion, you know...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you sooo much, Tsukasa! I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Teehee! What will our first show be?
Oh, can we make it about life among the stars?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh... I have no choice now, do I...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... But this could make for a compelling origin story. Setting out on my path to stardom amongst overwhelming difficulties... Yes, I should stay positive!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, if I'm doing this, I'm going to make it a show worthy of the world's top star-to-be!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! Let's make it a fun-tastic magical experience!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Before we can begin, we need to recruit more members for our troupe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The two of us aren't enough?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even including Mr. Mascot here we only have a cast of three. That's not enough for a proper show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I see! The more the merrier, right?
Let's go and find more members!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Easier said than done... How do we find people who'd like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look, Tsukasa! Tiny robots!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Robots? Are you lost in your fantasies again?
Oh... You weren't kidding...
Hehe. My little darlings are all very energized today. Why? Because we'll be putting on a show here!
My dear mechanical actors, it's showtime!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What am I even looking at?!
